children: SoftBank Group Corp. Unsponsored ADR (TSE:9984) is doubling down on AI—adding about $30B to OpenAI to reach a ~$64.6B stake, pricing an $11B high‑yield bond to fund more AI deals and courting Gulf capital—while exploring an $18B Allied Universal buy amid volatile stock drops and wider funding costs.
SoftBank Group Corp. Unsponsored ADR Sees Large OpenAI Stake
: SoftBank (9984) added ~$30B to OpenAI, raising its reported OpenAI stake to ~$64.6B (~13%). Company says AI is central to its portfolio and seeks large Gulf funding for more AI deals.
SoftBank Group Bond Sold For AI Investments
: SoftBank Group (9984) priced a record $11B high-yield bond due 2034 with a 9.75% coupon; yields/credit spreads widened since June. Proceeds aimed at AI investments, including OpenAI.
SoftBank Group Corp. Unsponsored ADR Eyeing Allied Universal
: SoftBank Group Corp. Unsponsored ADR (9984) is in early talks to buy U.S. security firm Allied Universal for about $18B (excluding debt); talks are preliminary, no price or deal terms finalized.
SoftBank ADR Drops From Peak Amid Volatility
: SoftBank ADR (9984) fell about 38% from its June peak, had single‑day drops near 8.5% and 8.1%, later partial rebounds around 1.5–3.4%, with rising funding costs and wider CDS spreads.
